1. Round the values to whole numbers and pad the image with the border mode.
2. For every window size from 3 to the largest, compute the min, median and max of all windows.
3. For each pixel, find the first size whose median lies strictly between its min and max.
4. Keep the pixel if it also lies strictly between them, or write the median. If no size fits, write the median of the largest window.
